records.scope: Native wallet proving; distinct from the cubic block-v2 wallet profile

facts.label: profile

exclusions: No recursive aggregation or complete transaction latency

records.profile: Candidate cubic block-v2 verifier inside one outer STARK

facts.label: includes
facts.value: Raw serialized inner-proof witness inputs to native outer BatchProof, with resident GPU witness, lookup, quotient, commitments, openings, FRI and final proof-field readback.

facts.label: excludes
facts.value: Context/module startup, public program compilation, inner wallet proof generation, public preprocessing preparation, final Postcard serialization and independent CPU verification.

exclusions: Not a full-block, worker-pool, or production wrapper/merge benchmark

Serialization excluded from outer proving timer

records.profile: Historical October 17 paired 128-entry block-v2 GPU profile
records.scope: Full aggregation of 96 user and 32 issuance entries; one measured sequential block

facts.label: scope
facts.value: One complete 128-transaction block per mode, with 96 user and 32 issuance transactions. Two sibling 64-transaction subtrees feed one final root.

exclusions: Excludes wallet generation, key preparation, independent audits, and durable host application
Historical backend; not a measurement of latest CUDA full-block performance
One block per mode; no sustained-throughput qualification

records.scope: Five observed serialized inner wallet artifacts from CUDA recursion qualification; no transaction or speed claim
exclusions: Artifact sizes from qualification receipts, not a matched wallet generation benchmark
Excludes transaction public body, encrypted outputs and framing
Fresh randomized proofs can vary in size; these observations are not a maximum-proof bound
